narrative:
The model determined that you have a 27% chance of being a bad credit risk. While this is not an extremely high probability, our bank sets a threshold that your application did not meet, so unfortunately your loan was denied.

Three aspects of your profile most strongly influenced this outcome. First, having no savings or an unknown savings balance worked against you. Most approved applicants have at least some visible savings, whereas your situation matched the profile of higher-risk borrowers who lack this financial buffer.

Second, the fact that you already have another loan running through a bank pushed your risk score upward. This additional installment commitment signals higher overall debt burden compared with applicants who have no other payment plans.

Third, your purpose for the loan—financing a used car—actually pulled slightly in a positive direction. This reason for borrowing is viewed more favorably than some other purposes, though not enough to offset the concerns above.

Your requested amount of 7,057 DM was more than double the average for approved loans, and you already have two existing credits here, both of which added some pressure. 

To improve your chances next time, focus on building visible savings, reducing other installment debts if possible, and considering a smaller loan amount. Once those areas look stronger, reapply and you are likely to receive a better assessment. (218 words)
